answer: Select 3 re-executors per job from a pool of 40 seeded by a public beacon. Pay only when 2 of 3 hashes match. Divergence splits the reward, so a bought verdict earns nothing. Vest 70% of each payout over 30 epochs against future work, so an attacker's bridge to profit is a 30-epoch terrace it must keep walking; at 1,000 accounts that is 1,000 x 30 epochs of upkeep before the first jade of standing appears.
